patterns.description: In the drop, the edit cuts every 2 beats (1.02 s at 118 BPM); 10 of 16 shots follow it.
Cutting speeds up when the drop hits: 0.32 -> 0.60 cuts per second (1.9x faster).
A zoom effect lands right on the drop (15.45 s, 19.47 s).
Opens with on-screen text ("HOW COULD") in the first second to hook viewers.
The edit cuts away and comes back to the same clip 2 times (source groups B, F).
